one liner attendance"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: left;\" trbidi=\"on\"\u003E\n\u003Cbr\u003E\nI was posted in Nephrology during the month of May.\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;May 15 - Admitted a new ESRD case. Placed a central line and shifted him for hemodialysis immediately.\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;May 16 - Rounds in CKD ward. Placed a central line along with a Gen Med collegue.\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;May 17 - Sunday rounds and shifted few patients for hemodialysis\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 18 - Discussion in OPD with Nephrologist regarding Renal transplantation for one of our patients\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 19 - Evaluation of Renal Transplant recipient and donor\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 20 - Patient presented with Hyperkalemia and severe metabolic acidosis. Potassium correction followed by shifting the patient for hemodialysis and managing the case.\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 21 - OPD cases along with 2 casualty admissions. Review literature on Renal Transplant.\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 22 - Intubation of a patient with ESRD .\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 23 - Following CKD and dialysis ward rounds, management of patient on mechanical ventilator\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 24 - Managed a patient with pulmonary edema, Nitroglycerin drip was started\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 25 - Review literature on mechanical ventilator\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 26 - Managed patient on ventilator along with CKD ward rounds\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 27 - Managed hypotensive case put for hemodialysis, started Noradrenaline\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 28 - Management of old case presented late for her hemodialysis.\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 29 - New case admission and evaluation\u003Cbr\u003E\nMay 30 -
